snippet.title: Éalú - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Now available on Steam
Soundtrack available on all major streaming platforms

Éalú is a fully stop-motion animated puzzle/adventure game produced and developed by Beyond the Bark, featuring an original score by Will Wood. In this spiritual semi-sequel to Beyond the Bark's "Tomcat Disposables" video, take the care of a wooden clockwork mouse  into your hands and guide him to freedom. Solve challenging hand-crafted puzzles, explore a mysterious maze, and find out if there's cheese in the great beyond - and if it's worth it.

Purchase the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560370/al/
